description_en: Modifies the logon password of a Smart Access Gateway device
description_zh: 调用ModifySAGAdminPassword接口修改智能接入网关设备的登录密码
name: ModifySAGAdminPassword

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The new logon password for the Smart Access Gateway device.

Password format requirements: The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

The example shows a partially masked synthetic format for demonstration purposes and does not correspond to a real device password. An asterisk () indicates a masked character and does not mean that asterisks () are supported in passwords. When entering a password, refer to the password format requirements
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关设备新的登录密码。

密码格式要求：密码长度为8~30个字符，可包含大小写字母、数字和下划线（_）。

示例为部分遮盖的合成格式演示，不对应真实设备密码。星号（\）表示遮盖字符，不表示密码支持使用星号（\），输入密码时请以密码格式要求为准
parameters.name: password
